Reconstructed all 62 verses of **لے چل ہوا کربلا** in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions align verse by verse, with an unnumbered opening and six numbered stanzas grouped using the refrain. Updated the title and text direction, removed `noUrdu`, and verified the diff.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Mashee” as **مشی** and “Chale” as **چھالے** from context.
